from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); now_year=now.year; now_month=now.month
super_cards=apis.supervisor.show_payment_cards()
print('Supervisor all payment cards:', [(c['card_name'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'], c['card_number']) for c in super_cards])
expired_super=[c for c in super_cards if (c['expiry_year'], int(c['expiry_month'])) < (now_year, now_month)]
print('Supervisor expired cards:', [(c['card_name'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'], c['card_number']) for c in expired_super])

creds={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

spotify_token=apis.spotify.login(username=email, password=creds['spotify'])['access_token']
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username=email, password=creds['venmo'])['access_token']
print('Tokens obtained')

def fetch_cards(app_name, token):
    if app_name=='amazon':
        data=apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=token)
    elif app_name=='spotify':
        data=apis.spotify.show_payment_cards(access_token=token)
    elif app_name=='venmo':
        data=apis.venmo.show_payment_cards(access_token=token)
    else:
        data=[]
    return data

amazon_cards=fetch_cards('amazon', amazon_token)
spotify_cards=fetch_cards('spotify', spotify_token)
venmo_cards=fetch_cards('venmo', venmo_token)

print('amazon_cards:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'], c['card_number']) for c in amazon_cards])
print('spotify_cards:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'], c['card_number']) for c in spotify_cards])
print('venmo_cards:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'], c['card_number']) for c in venmo_cards])

# compute expired in each app
exp_fn=lambda c: (c['expiry_year'], int(c['expiry_month'])) < (now_year, now_month)
amazon_exp=[c for c in amazon_cards if exp_fn(c)]
spotify_exp=[c for c in spotify_cards if exp_fn(c)]
venmo_exp=[c for c in venmo_cards if exp_fn(c)]

print('Expired IDs amazon:', [c['payment_card_id'] for c in amazon_exp])
print('Expired IDs spotify:', [c['payment_card_id'] for c in spotify_exp])
print('Expired IDs venmo:', [c['payment_card_id'] for c in venmo_exp])

# match to supervisor expired by card_number
expired_numbers=set(c['card_number'] for c in expired_super)

def filter_match(app_exp):
    return [c for c in app_exp if c['card_number'] in expired_numbers]

amazon_match=filter_match(amazon_exp)
spotify_match=filter_match(spotify_exp)
venmo_match=filter_match(venmo_exp)
print('Matched expired (by card_number) amazon:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['card_number']) for c in amazon_match])
print('Matched expired (by card_number) spotify:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['card_number']) for c in spotify_match])
print('Matched expired (by card_number) venmo:', [(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['card_number']) for c in venmo_match])

from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now(); now_year=now.year; now_month=now.month

# recompute current cards per app (no pagination expected)
creds = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
email = profile['email']
amazon_token = apis.amazon.login(username=email, password=creds['amazon'])['access_token']
spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username=email, password=creds['spotify'])['access_token']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username=email, password=creds['venmo'])['access_token']

amazon_cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amazon_token)
spotify_cards = apis.spotify.show_payment_cards(access_token=spotify_token)
venmo_cards = apis.venmo.show_payment_cards(access_token=venmo_token)

expired_fn = lambda c: (c['expiry_year'], int(c['expiry_month'])) < (now_year, now_month)

# criteria enumeration counts
apps_with_payment_cards = {'amazon': amazon_cards, 'spotify': spotify_cards, 'venmo': venmo_cards}
all_cards_total = sum(len(v) for v in apps_with_payment_cards.values())
expired_total = sum(sum(1 for c in v if expired_fn(c)) for v in apps_with_payment_cards.values())

print('CRITERIA TABLE')
print({'Criterion':'all my app accounts that have payment cards', 'Exact Quote from Task':'all my app accounts that have payment cards', 'Implementation':'Only apps exposing show_payment_cards/delete_payment_card: amazon, spotify, venmo'})
print({'Criterion':'expired payment cards', 'Exact Quote from Task':'Remove expired payment cards', 'Implementation': 'expiry_year, expiry_month < current year/month'})
print('COUNTS:')
print('Total cards across apps:', all_cards_total)
print('Total expired cards to remove:', expired_total)

# build target set of deletions

target_deletions=[]
for app_name, cards in apps_with_payment_cards.items():
    for c in cards:
        if expired_fn(c):
            target_deletions.append({
                'app': app_name,
                'payment_card_id': c['payment_card_id'],
                'card_name': c['card_name'],
                'card_number': c['card_number'],
                'expiry_year': c['expiry_year'],
                'expiry_month': int(c['expiry_month']),
                'expired': True,
            })

print('\nTarget deletions (expected):', len(target_deletions))
for td in target_deletions:
    print(td)

# verification table
print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE:')
for td in target_deletions:
    print(f"App={td['app']} | ID={td['payment_card_id']} | Card={td['card_name']} | Exp={td['expiry_month']:02d}/{td['expiry_year']} | Expired? {td['expired']}")

# capture tokens for next step
tokens={'amazon': amazon_token, 'spotify': spotify_token, 'venmo': venmo_token}
print('\nTokens prepared for delete step:', list(tokens.keys()))
